content.text:
Loan 6 (Jason Esposito, LN-2024-00103, 9288 Nations Ford Rd) — borrower explicitly withdrew on 2024-08-22 via email to Sofia Reyes/Keisha Williams (personal situation changed, not the right time to buy).

All 6 investigated. Note: LOS has no activity log or milestone data for any of these files (all empty), and all documents show status "received" (none reviewed/approved) with created_at dates of 2026-07-02 — the LOS records appear to be a stale snapshot; the dispositive evidence is entirely in email. Here are the structured findings.

---

**LOAN LN-2025-00305 — Gerald Bryant — LO Brian Mitchell (TERMINATED 2025-04-15) — status=conditional_approval**
- Lock: expired 2025-06-01 (~331 days ago)
- Outstanding conditions: 0 in LOS (empty). Per lender email 2025-04-22: 4 UW conditions issued (pay stub, bank stmts, appraisal, VVOE) — never cleared.
- Outstanding docs: 14 received, 0 reviewed/approved.
- Last activity / last milestone: no LOS activity/milestones. Last email 2025-05-11 (~352 days dormant).
- BLOCKER / likely disposition: **DENIED / fell through.** Homepoint Financial declined LN-2025-00305 on 2025-05-11 — could not complete employment verification; adverse action notice to be sent. Should be marked denied.
- Flags: Assigned LO terminated 2025-04-15, but file worked by processor Sofia Reyes (LO of record mismatch). Loan still marked active ~1 yr after denial. Realtor Derrick pushing for a May 22 close that never happened.

**LOAN LN-2025-00286 — Fatima O'Connor — LO Natasha Okafor — status=clear_to_close**
- Lock: expired 2025-05-12 (~351 days ago)
- Outstanding conditions: 0 in LOS. Per Caliber email 2025-04-05: 4 UW conditions issued (pay stub, bank stmts, appraisal, VOE).
- Outstanding docs: 13 received (incl. closing_disclosure), 0 reviewed/approved.
- Last activity / last milestone: no LOS activity/milestones. Last email 2025-04-29 (~364 days dormant).
- BLOCKER / likely disposition: **WITHDRAWN.** Borrower emailed 2025-04-29 (cc Natasha) explicitly withdrawing: "decided not to move forward with the purchase." Should be marked withdrawn, not clear_to_close.
- Flags: Refi that borrower killed while file sat at CTC. Status never updated.

**LOAN LN-2025-00244 — Rosa Weiss — LO Priya Desai — status=processing**
- Lock: expired 2025-03-21 (~403 days ago)
- Outstanding conditions: 0 in LOS; no lender conditions email found specific to LN-2025-00244 (Rosa/7974 Sharon Rd).
- Outstanding docs: 10 received, 0 reviewed/approved (no appraisal/URAR, no VOE, no closing disclosure on file).
- Last activity / last milestone: no LOS activity/milestones. Last relevant email 2025-02-06 (~15 months dormant); everything then read on-track for a March 17, 2025 close.
- BLOCKER / likely disposition: **GENUINELY STUCK / abandoned.** No denial, withdrawal, or closing confirmation anywhere. File was tracking toward March 17, 2025 close, then went silent — stalled in processing and never resolved. Needs a live status call to borrower/agent.
- Flags: **Compliance —** borrower disclosed a previously-omitted Best Buy card (~$800) on 2025-02-05 (undisclosed liability). Handled by processor Sofia Reyes, not LO of record Priya Desai (assignment mismatch). Loan record status "processing" is far behind actual (pre-close) stage.

**LOAN LN-2024-00125 — Megan Rao — LO Marcus Webb — status=underwriting**
- Lock: expired 2024-10-17 (~558 days ago)
- Outstanding conditions: 0 in LOS. Per AmeriHome email 2024-09-06: 4 UW conditions issued.
- Outstanding docs: 12 received, 0 reviewed/approved.
- Last activity / last milestone: no LOS activity/milestones. Last email 2024-10-06 (~18.5 months dormant).
- BLOCKER / likely disposition: **DENIED / fell through.** AmeriHome declined 2024-10-03 (DTI over threshold); lender confirmed file "officially closed" on their end 2024-10-04. Borrower coached to pay down debt and possibly reapply. Should be marked denied.
- Flags: A separate borrower Victor T Rao (LN-2024-00163) was also denied for DTI — unrelated file. This loan sat in "underwriting" ~1.5 yrs after denial.

**LOAN LN-2024-00123 — Karen Parker — LO Amy Chen — status=conditional_approval**
- Lock: expired 2024-10-07 (~568 days ago)
- Outstanding conditions: 0 in LOS. Per Flagstar email 2024-08-30: 4 UW conditions issued.
- Outstanding docs: 13 received, 0 reviewed/approved.
- Last activity / last milestone: no LOS activity/milestones. Last relevant email 2024-09-21 (~19 months dormant).
- BLOCKER / likely disposition: **DENIED / fell through.** Flagstar Wholesale declined LN-2024-00123 on 2024-09-21 (DTI over threshold); adverse action notice mailed. Target close was Oct 3, 2024 — did not happen. Should be marked denied.
- Flags: File worked by processor Sofia Reyes; LO of record Amy Chen (initial referral was Derek Moss). Denied loan still marked conditional_approval ~19 months later.

**LOAN LN-2024-00103 — Jason Esposito — LO Keisha Williams — status=processing**
- Lock: expired 2024-09-08 (~597 days ago)
- Outstanding conditions: 0 in LOS; no lender conditions email tied to LN-2024-00103.
- Outstanding docs: 8 received, 0 reviewed/approved (no appraisal/URAR doc on file, though appraisal for 9288 Nations Ford Rd was completed ~July 2024).
- Last activity / last milestone: no LOS activity/milestones. Last email 2024-08-22 (~20 months dormant).
- BLOCKER / likely disposition: **WITHDRAWN.** Borrower emailed 2024-08-22 (cc Keisha Williams) withdrawing LN-2024-00103 — "things have changed in my personal situation... not the right time to buy." Should be marked withdrawn.
- Flags: File was worked by processor Sofia Reyes; withdrawal never processed in LOS, still shows "processing" ~20 months later. Many unrelated Esposito files in inbox (Sarah, Deepa, Takeshi, Hana) — do not conflate.

---

Summary of dispositions: **Denied/fell through (3):** Bryant, Rao, Parker (all DTI/VOE lender declines). **Withdrawn by borrower (2):** O'Connor, Esposito. **Genuinely stuck/abandoned (1):** Rosa Weiss — no resolution on record, needs follow-up. Every file is stale by ~11–20 months past a long-expired rate lock and none of the LOS statuses reflect reality. Cross-cutting flags: LO-of-record vs. actual-worker mismatches on nearly every file (Sofia Reyes processed most), a terminated LO (Bryant), and an undisclosed-debt compliance item on Weiss.

All five investigators returned. I now have a full picture. Before I write anything, let me verify the most consequential findings — the loans that appear **denied or withdrawn but still marked active** — directly from the email record, since these drive my recommendations to Grace and the LOs.

============================================================

CLEAR TO CLOSE
- LN-2026-00623 Vincent Pham — LO Priya Desai — lock exp 4/1 (27d). Marked CTC but the 3/23 closing date passed with no closing; still shows missing income/ID docs, which is odd at CTC. Next: confirm whether it closed, relock, clean up docs.

FIRST-TOUCH / EARLY
- LN-2026-00010 Vincent Ferguson — LO Natasha Okafor — lock exp 4/24 (4d). Early processing; ~7 core docs never collected (income, credit, appraisal, VOE, HOI). TITLE ISSUE: an unresolved recorded mechanic's lien at 578 Morehead St (Tryon Title, 4/6) — flagged under a "Ferguson refi / Melissa Ferguson," same address as this purchase; please confirm the files aren't conflated and whether the lien clouds this title. **The whole queue is in trouble:** every one of your 26 files has an **expired rate lock** and missed LE/CD deadlines. Beyond that, the queue breaks into four groups:

- **LN-2026-00008 Yuki Wilson** — appraisal never ordered, HOI missing, 48 days off-lock.
- **LN-2026-00010 Ferguson** — early processing + an unresolved **mechanic's-lien title issue** at 578 Morehead St.

**6 files marked active but actually DONE** (LOS is wrong):
- **Denied:** Rao (LN-2024-00125), Parker (LN-2024-00123), Bryant (LN-2025-00305), Allen (LN-2025-00314) — all confirmed from lender emails.

**5 dormant files** (9–13 months, no closing on record) needing disposition: Huang, A. Reyes, Wright, M. Pham, Weiss.

- **Grace** — full pipeline report emailed, broken down by status, LO, and blocker/next step, with dedicated sections on denied/withdrawn/dormant files and the terminated-LO assignments.

- **LOS** — added a triage activity note to all 26 loans.
- **CRM** — logged the full triage as a NOTE engagement.

**One judgment call worth noting:** I did *not* unilaterally change any loan statuses (e.g., flip the denied/withdrawn files) — I documented the discrepancies and recommended corrections to Grace/compliance instead, since status changes and adverse-action verification are theirs to own. I also treated a few broad-search leads (a CFPB "Aisha Walker" complaint, an "Abigail Clark" transfer request, a terminated-staffer name collision on "Evan Mercer") as unverified and kept them out of the official reports to avoid relaying mis-correlated data.
